full_prompt_en: A square contemporary cartoon illustration frames a young woman from the chest upward against a dense wall of stylized flowers and leaves. She has a rounded dark-brown bob with straight short bangs, oversized black glasses, wide teal eyes, and a small open mouth, as if she has just noticed something unexpected off to the right. Both hands hold a broad muted-turquoise cup close to her chest. Her ochre short-sleeved top is sprinkled with tiny white flower motifs, and dark suspender-like straps run over the shoulders. Behind her, cream daisies with tan centers, ochre blooms, teal leaves, and thin stems fill the entire background without a horizon or open sky. The figure remains distinct because her skin is a broad pale-cream shape and her dark hair forms a strong silhouette against the patterned flowers. Outlines are thick, clean, and slightly irregular; shadow planes on the chin, fingers, and hair are blocked in with muted gray-green and brown rather than smooth airbrush gradients. Fine short marks add texture to leaves, petals, and clothing print. The palette is deliberately narrow: deep teal, charcoal brown, warm ochre, cream, and dusty turquoise. Light is soft and even, with flat graphic shadow shapes rather than a clear cast shadow. The close crop and dense pattern keep attention on the startled expression and the cup held between the hands. There is no readable text. The whole image feels cozy, quirky, and alert, balancing a simple expressive character against an intricate, wallpaper-like botanical field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形当代卡通插画把一名年轻女子从胸口以上框在密集的程式化花叶墙前。她有圆润深棕波波头和齐短刘海、夸张黑框眼镜、睁大的蓝绿眼睛，以及微微张开的嘴，像刚看到右方某件意料外的事。双手把一个宽大的柔暗绿松石杯子捧在胸前。赭黄色短袖上衣撒着细小白花图案，深色吊带般的带子越过肩膀。身后，奶油色雏菊配褐色花心、赭色花、蓝绿叶和细茎填满整个背景，没有地平线或空天空。人物仍清楚，因为皮肤是宽阔淡奶油形，而深发在花纹前形成强剪影。轮廓厚实干净且略不规则；下巴、手指和头发上的阴影用柔暗灰绿与棕色平面铺出，不用平滑喷绘渐层。细短笔痕给叶、花瓣与衣服印花添肌理。调色刻意狭窄：深蓝绿、炭棕、暖赭、奶油与灰绿松石。光线柔和均匀，有平面的图形阴影而非明确投影。贴近裁切与密纹把注意力留在惊讶表情和双手间的杯子上。没有可读文字。整幅图舒适、古怪而警觉，以简单有表情的人物平衡繁密如墙纸的植物场。
style_prompt_en: Contemporary cartoon illustration uses thick clean yet slightly irregular outlines, compact flat shadow planes, and a tightly limited earthy palette. Deep teal, charcoal brown, warm ochre, pale cream, and dusty turquoise repeat across a dense all-over pattern. A broad light focal shape and a dark rounded silhouette remain readable despite intricate small motifs behind them. Short texture marks give otherwise flat surfaces tactile life, while tiny repeated dots and organic forms create wallpaper-like rhythm. Lighting is soft and even; color blocking supplies depth instead of realistic cast shadows. Tight cropping keeps the central focal area clear within the crowded frame, producing a cozy, offbeat energy.
style_prompt_zh: 当代卡通插画使用厚实干净却略不规则的轮廓、紧凑平面阴影和严格收窄的大地调色。深蓝绿、炭棕、暖赭、淡奶油与灰绿松石在密集满铺图案里重复。宽阔浅色焦点与深色圆润剪影在背后繁细小纹样前仍可读。短肌理痕让其他较平的表面有触感，细小重复点与有机形带来墙纸般节奏。照明柔和均匀，色块分割代替真实投影建立深度。贴近裁切让中央焦点区域在拥挤画幅内清楚，产生舒适而古怪的活力。
theme_en: A bespectacled young woman holding a teal cup before a dense flower wall
theme_zh: 戴眼镜的年轻女子手捧蓝绿杯子，身后是密集花墙
name: Kate Leth
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
